events.label: Whistleblower lawsuit
events.note: A former executive sued on July 7, alleging retaliation after he reported concerns about the accounting. Alignment says the claims are without merit.

events.label: After second-quarter results
events.note: Results beat forecasts, but on the call managers said they would reinvest some of the gains, according to StockStory.

events.label: Rising costs
events.note: At an investor conference on Sept. 15, executives talked about higher hospital and nursing-home costs, the Orange County Business Journal reported.

events.label: Half a star
events.note: Medicare's 2027 ratings, released Oct. 8 after the close, cut the main California plan to 3.5 stars.

events.label: Lower forecast
events.note: Third-quarter results on Oct. 29, after the close: medical costs ran higher than expected and profit guidance came down.
